review_design: Focused evidence synthesis extending a retained eleven-target nominee map; not an exhaustive systematic review

sources.access: Retained main article and assessed figure material in the nominee evidence map
sources.product: Mouse models and separate human stem-cell-derived beta-cell preparations
sources.observation: Autoimmune protection and lack of protection in the tested mouse allograft model; glucose-responsive baseline human preparations
sources.boundary: Baseline human secretion is not post-immune function; model-specific protection cannot be transferred across species or graft settings
sources.locator: Extended Data Figure 10c; Supplement S1 experiment records FE017 and FE018

sources.access: Retained primary article and screen inputs; quantitative reanalysis retained separately

sources.access: Retained full article, figures and comparison-level extraction

sources.access: Full primary article and relevant figures assessed

sources.observation: Favorable live CD45-negative counts and live/dead ratios after72h IL2-stimulated HLA-mismatched PBMC exposure

sources.access: Full primary article and retained baseline figures assessed

sources.access: Complete main text and main figure legends plus all six publisher supplementary files assessed; separate main-panel images not downloaded
sources.product: RNLS-deficient beta cells in autoimmune and immune-metabolic models
sources.observation: Metabolic, immune and graft outcomes without a located direct secretion assay in assessed material

sources.access: Primary abstract and bibliographic record; complete article and supplements not obtained

sources.observation: Glucose-responsive C-peptide and no detected response against modified cells during12weeks

sources.access: Primary journal indexed abstract and bibliographic record; full letter and supplements not obtained
sources.observation: Abstract reports beta-cell function and no detected allograft immune response through14months

sources.access: Complete primary abstract and bibliographic record assessed; full text and supplements not assessed
sources.product: Engineered primary HUMAN donor pseudoislets with HLA-I/II-negative CD47-overexpressing phenotype; not a stem-cell product
sources.observation: Survival, endocrine function and diabetes amelioration in allogeneic humanized mice; separate abstract-reported avoidance of autoimmune killing in an autologous humanized model
sources.boundary: Do not assign duration, sample size or direct paired post-immune secretion completeness from the abstract; no per-survivor rate or clinical efficacy established

sources.access: Retained complete primary XML; relevant Results, Methods and Figure2/3 legends assessed
sources.product: PD-L1-expressing human iPSC-derived WNT4-matured islet-like organoids; separate repeated-IFN-gamma induction arm not conflated
sources.observation: Glycemic control beyond50days in immunocompetent mouse xenografts; humanized mice show glycemic and circulating human C-peptide benefits
sources.boundary: Mouse hosts, not human trial; concentrations/glycemia are not direct secretion per surviving beta cell; model-specific result does not establish universal PD-L1 protection

search_extension.engines: Primary article repositories, journal indexing, PubMed, public trial registry, and focused web discovery
representative_queries: RNLS HIVEP2 post immune glucose stimulated insulin secretion human
